environment.materials: A 26000 CNY receipt from the receivables page, its receivable, invoice, sales order and fund account

replication.notes: RISEMAP current collection-flow page is empty; title, metrics, statuses, filters, columns and empty state are observed, while row actions and same-material outcomes remain unavailable.

visual.notes: Populated desktop and 390x844 narrow views, filtered empty state, allocation form and confirmation dialogs were checked in the built-in browser. Independent visual review remains pending.

interaction.notes: Forge required and over-amount blocking, allocation, cancellation, approval and reversal ordering passed. RISEMAP row-level behavior remains unavailable.

business.notes: Forge receipt, allocation, receivable, invoice, order and fund-account readback passed before and after same-SQLite restart. RISEMAP same-material business outcome remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Open both current pages and compare title, description, metrics, statuses and columns.
requirements.observed: Authentication was fixed and the Forge page now shows real records with the observed structure; pending review is an explicit Forge execution extension.

requirements.steps: Search, switch status, expand advanced filters and reset.
requirements.expected: Filters have clear list scope while summary remains global.
requirements.observed: Status, filtered empty state, advanced-filter toggle and reset passed without changing global metrics.

requirements.steps: Submit an incomplete allocation, an over-amount allocation and a valid allocation.
requirements.expected: Invalid actions are blocked and a valid action creates a pending allocation.
requirements.observed: Forge paths passed; RISEMAP row behavior remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Cancel one allocation, allocate again and approve.
requirements.expected: Cancellation releases the receipt balance; approval settles the receivable and invoice and updates the order.
requirements.observed: Forge cancellation and final approval passed; RISEMAP same-material behavior remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Attempt invalid receipt reversal, reverse an approved allocation and restore the final settlement.
requirements.expected: Invalid order is blocked and reversal restores every rollup with an audit record.
requirements.observed: Forge blocking, reversal log, restored balances and final re-approval passed; allocation-detail visual review remains pending.

requirements.steps: Check desktop and 390x844 views with data, filtered empty state, allocation form and confirmation.
requirements.expected: Usable first screen without page-level overflow; wide table scrolls inside its card.
requirements.observed: Desktop and narrow views passed, including stacked advanced dates and complete dialogs.

requirements.steps: Read receipt, allocations, receivable, invoice, order and account, restart the same SQLite and read again.
requirements.expected: Source, amount, statuses and balances remain consistent.
requirements.observed: Forge readback passed before and after restart; RISEMAP same-material outcome remains unavailable.
